Class Enemy

java.lang.Object
logic.enemy.Enemy
All Implemented Interfaces:
Damageable
Direct Known Subclasses:
BatEnemy, BigSlimeEnemy, DemonEnemy, GoblinEnemy, KingSlimeEnemy, SkeletonEnemy, SlimeEnemy, ZombieEnemy
public class Enemy extends Object implements Damageable
Base enemy model used by all enemy variants in the game.

An enemy tracks combat stats, world position, path-following state, sprite/animation state, and hit-flash state.

  • Constructor Details

    • Enemy

      public Enemy(int maxHealth, double speed, int rewardMoney, String spriteName, int damage)
      Creates an enemy with the provided combat and rendering stats.
      Parameters:
      maxHealth - maximum and initial health
      speed - movement speed per update tick
      rewardMoney - money granted when the enemy dies
      spriteName - resource path for the enemy sprite
      damage - base damage dealt when reaching the base

  • Method Details
